title: Seeing Why: Exact Evidence Maps for Quantum and Optical Image Classifiers (code and data)
description: Code, trained models, Caltech-10 data and the IBM hardware record for the paper "Seeing Why: Exact Evidence Maps for Quantum and Optical Image Classifiers" (arXiv:2611.01993). Version 1.2 matches arXiv v3: the chip maps of 30 pictures drawn at random, the checks of two review rounds, and the test set of model A′ (no mask) on the chip, with the paired McNemar test against D′.
